_notes.purpose: Quarterly MASS-market table hold (win as % of table drop) and mass drop per property, built ONLY from primary operator disclosures (SEC EDGAR 10-Q / 10-K MD&A operating-measure tables and Melco 6-K EX-99.1 earnings releases). Built 2026-08-10 to support a decomposition of hold into property trend + composition effect + residual.

CRITICAL_drop_definitions_are_not_cross_.rule: Compare a property ONLY to its own history. Cross-operator HOLD LEVELS are meaningless because each operator defines the drop denominator differently.
CRITICAL_drop_definitions_are_not_cross_.Wynn (Wynn Palace, Wynn Macau): mass drop = cash deposited in the table drop box PLUS cash chips purchased at the casino CAGE. Cage inclusion inflates the denominator and depresses the reported hold level.
CRITICAL_drop_definitions_are_not_cross_.LVS (Venetian, Londoner, Parisian, Plaza: Non-Rolling Chip drop = net markers issued + cash in the table drop boxes + gaming chips purchased AND EXCHANGED at the cage. Broadest denominator of the three.
CRITICAL_drop_definitions_are_not_cross_.MGM (MGM China): main-floor drop = total cash and net markers issued deposited INTO THE DROP BOX. No cage-purchase component in the stated definition.
CRITICAL_drop_definitions_are_not_cross_.Melco (City of Dreams, Studio City, Alti: 'mass market table games drop' is the table-level buy-in measure and does NOT carry the cage-chip component Wynn and LVS add. This is why Melco's reported mass hold sits at 28-37% while Wynn/LVS sit at 14-30% for economically similar play. It is a denominator artifact, NOT superior game performance.
CRITICAL_drop_definitions_are_not_cross_.practical_consequence: Level differences across operators (e.g. Studio City 33% vs Venetian 23%) carry no information. Only within-property time series, and cross-property comparisons of CHANGES/z-scores, are valid.

premium_vs_base_mass_splits.finding: NO operator discloses a numeric premium-mass vs base-mass drop or hold split in any primary filing. This was checked across all Wynn/LVS/MGM 10-Qs and 10-Ks 2018-2026 and all Melco earnings releases.
premium_vs_base_mass_splits.what_exists: LVS gives qualitative commentary only ('premium patrons', 'premium suite expansion at The Venetian Macao'). MGM's 'main floor' is already the mass aggregate and explicitly includes premium main-floor play in premium gaming lounges; it is not separable. Wynn and Melco give none.
premium_vs_base_mass_splits.usable_proxy: Wynn is the ONE operator that discloses an instrument that lets composition be estimated indirectly: it publishes AVERAGE NUMBER OF TABLE GAMES separately for VIP and for mass, per property, per quarter. Table reallocation from VIP to mass, combined with drop-per-table and win-per-unit-per-day, identifies a mix shift. Those table counts are carried on every Wynn row here as avg_vip_tables / avg_mass_tables.
premium_vs_base_mass_splits.why_mix_moves_hold: Reported hold on DROP = (theoretical house edge) x (handle / drop). Drop is the initial buy-in; handle is total wagered. Premium-mass players recycle chips far more times per buy-in, so their handle/drop multiple is much higher and their hold-ON-DROP is structurally higher even at an unchanged house edge. A shift toward premium mass therefore raises reported hold WITHOUT any change in luck or in game rules.

stated_expected_hold_ranges.Wynn - Macau mass: NOT disclosed. Wynn states expected table-games win % only for Las Vegas (22%-26%) and Encore Boston Harbor (18%-22%). For Macau it gives only the qualitative explanation that VIP and mass measurement bases are not comparable.
stated_expected_hold_ranges.LVS - Macau non-rolling: LVS does not give a forward expected range for non-rolling; it discloses a TRAILING-12-MONTH win %. As of the Q2-2026 10-Q: Venetian 22.3%, Londoner 22.4%, Parisian 21.0%, Plaza/Four Seasons 21.4%, Sands Macao 14.7%, Marina Bay Sands 22.9%. Its expected ROLLING chip win % in Macao is 3.3%.
stated_expected_hold_ranges.MGM - MGM China main floor: 2019-era 10-K/10-Q stated 'win for main floor gaming operations at MGM China is typically in the range of 16% to 22% of table games drop'. That statement was DROPPED from later filings and actual main-floor hold has run 25-27% in 2025-2026, i.e. far above the old stated range - itself evidence of structural drift, not luck.
stated_expected_hold_ranges.Melco - rolling only: Melco states an expected ROLLING chip win rate range (2.85%-3.15% currently; 2.7%-3.0% in 2019). It states NO expected mass hold range.

galaxy.disclosure_assessment: GEG DOES disclose both mass table DROP and a mass HOLD (win rate) percentage. This is unusual for an HK-listed Macau operator and is a positive-disclosure finding. In every interim report, annual report and quarterly KPI announcement GEG prints a 'Gaming Statistics' table with three segments, each given as volume / win rate % / win: (1) VIP: 'Rolling Chip Volume' + 'Win Rate %' + 'Win'; (2) MASS: 'Mass Table Drop' + 'Win Rate %' + 'Win'; (3) 'Electronic Gaming Volume' + 'Win Rate %' + 'Win'; plus 'Total GGR Win'. The table is presented at Group level and repeated for Galaxy Macau, StarWorld Macau, Broadway Macau and City Clubs. Two standing footnotes govern it: 'Gaming statistics are presented before deducting commission and incentives' and 'Mass table drop includes the amount of table drop plus cash chips purchased at the cage.' What GEG does NOT disclose: mass table unit counts (number of mass tables), drop per table per day, mass hold split between grind mass and premium mass, and any hold % on a per-game basis (no baccarat-only hold). So mass hold is a blended mass-table figure, not game-specific.
definitional_caveats: MASS DROP DEFINITION IS BROAD: 'Mass table drop includes the amount of table drop plus cash chips purchased at the cage.' It is NOT the US-style drop-box measure. Because cash chips bought at the cage are added to the denominator, GEG's mass hold % runs structurally in the 20s, whereas a table-drop-only denominator produces a much higher figure.

DEFINITIONAL BREAK IN 2019: GEG's 1H2018 interim report (and earlier) used a DIFFERENT and narrower mass measure, labelled 'Mass Gaming' under a column header 'Turnover / Table Drop / Slots Handle' with 'Win/Hold %'. On that basis Galaxy Macau 1H2018 mass was 20,813 drop / 9,134 win / 43.9% hold. The SAME period restated onto the current broad basis in the 1H2019 interim report is 34,043 drop / 26.7%-ish hold at Galaxy Macau and 58,163 drop / 23.3% hold at Group. The 43.9% and the 23.3% are NOT comparable. All figures in the series below are on the current (broad, incl. cage cash chips) basis, taken from documents dated 2019 or later where possible.

VIP VOLUME DEFINITION ALSO CHANGED (2022): footnote for 'Rolling Chip Volume' reads 'Reflects junket rolling chip volume only' through FY2021, and 'Reflects sum of promoter and inhouse premium direct' from 2022 onward. Prior periods were restated: 1H2021 rolling chip volume was first reported as 83,943 (junket only) and later shown as 73,222 on the new basis; Q1 2021 was 47,235 then 55,334. MASS TABLE DROP was NOT restated across this change (Q1 2021 = 11,585 / 24.6% in both the 2021 and 2022 announcements), so the mass series is continuous.

'At the Group level the gaming statistics include Company owned resorts plus City Clubs' (footnote in the annual reports). Total GGR Win includes gaming win from City Clubs. Waldo Casino ceased operations on 31 October 2025.
Gaming statistics are stated BEFORE deducting commission and incentives, i.e. they are gross of reinvestment — this differs from net gaming revenue in the P&L.
GEG's separately disclosed 'luck' adjustment to Adjusted EBITDA is stated to reflect 'luck adjustments associated with our rolling chip program' (i.e. VIP hold), not mass hold.

nevada_gcb_las_vegas_control.notes:
PRIMARY SOURCE ONLY: Nevada Gaming Control Board 'Gaming Revenue Report' monthly PDFs, index at https://www.gaming.nv.gov/about/gaming-revenue/information/ (the /about/gaming-revenue-information/ path 404s). No Wayback used; every figure was read verbatim from a gaming.nv.gov PDF. Nothing estimated, interpolated or synthesized.

UNIT: primary series = CLARK COUNTY LAS VEGAS STRIP AREA, All Nonrestricted Locations. Statewide (All Nonrestricted Locations) is included alongside in the *_statewide fields.

ANNUAL METHOD: each calendar year is taken from the THIRD column block of that year's DECEMBER report, whose header reads 'Twelve Months - 1/1/YYYY to 12/31/YYYY' (older 2015-2017 layout: 'TWELVE MONTH SUMMARY - 01/01/YY TO 12/31/YY'). The value taken is the 'Win Percent' column on the Baccarat row and on the games/tables Total row.

DEFINITIONS / CAVEATS:
1. NV GCB 'Win Percent' for table games = win / drop, where DROP is the value of cash plus credit-instrument (marker) counters deposited in the table's drop box. It is NOT hold-on-turnover / hold-on-rolling-chips, so it is NOT directly comparable to Macau's VIP 'win rate on rolling chip turnover' (~2.8-3.5% theoretical). NV table 'win %' and Macau mass-table hold are closer in spirit but still differ in drop definition and credit treatment.
2. 'Baccarat' and 'Mini-Baccarat' are SEPARATE line items in the NV report. Only the BACCARAT line is captured here (that is the big-table/high-limit game). Mini-baccarat holds much lower (roughly 10-12%) and is excluded.
3. table_games_hold_pct is the report's 'Total' row for the section headed 'Table, Counter and Card Games' (2018+) / 'TOTAL GAMES & TABLES' (2015-2017). That total INCLUDES race book, sports pool, keno, bingo and card games (poker rake), so it is a broader denominator than pure banked table games; sports pool in particular has dragged it since mobile sports betting scaled. Card Games (poker) reports no win % at all and enters the total only through win.
4. 2015-2017 reports use a different (pipe-delimited, uppercase) layout; the same three-block structure applies.
5. 2020 is COVID-distorted (Nevada casinos closed 3/18/2020-6/4/2020).

WHAT COULD NOT BE OBTAINED:
- Calendar-year-2026-to-date hold %. NV GCB reports only three blocks (current month / three months / trailing twelve months); no report publishes a Jan-1-to-date figure mid-year, and DROP is never published, so a CY2026-YTD hold cannot be read from a primary source and was NOT computed. annual[2026] is therefore null.
- For reference only, the latest report (June 2026) prints a trailing-twelve-month block covering 7/1/2025-6/30/2026 (fiscal year 2026): Las Vegas Strip Baccarat win % = 16.20, Strip games/tables Total win % = 14.87 (source: https://www.gaming.nv.gov/siteassets/content/about/gaming-revenue/monthly-revenue-report----june-2026.pdf). This is a FISCAL year, not a calendar year, so it is deliberately not placed in annual[].

- Baccarat drop (denominator) is not published by NV GCB in this report at any frequency.

_analysis.method: Pre-period stats reported two ways: (A) literal 2018Q1-2024Q4 all quarters; (B) 2018Q1-2019Q4 + 2023Q1-2024Q4, i.e. EXCLUDING 2020-2022, when Macau border closures and zero-COVID produced volume-collapse artifacts (Londoner 6.9%, Plaza/FS 6.5%, Altira 4.8% quarters) that triple the SD and would mechanically shrink every 2026 z-score. (B) is the honest denominator. Trend = OLS of hold on quarter index over all non-COVID quarters 2018Q1-2025Q4 (fit strictly OUT OF SAMPLE of the tested H1-2026 points). z = (actual - trend) / residual SD. H1 z uses the 2-quarter mean with SE = residual_SD/sqrt(k).
_analysis.variance_decomposition: Fitted CV(hold residual)^2 = A/drop + B across the 12 Macau properties (A = card-luck component, scales as 1/volume; B = scale-free structural/mix floor). Result A=1.273 per $mm, B=0.00209. Card luck explains only 13-29% of residual variance at the large properties and the majority only at Altira and Sands Macao. Cross-check: log(CV) on log(drop) has slope -0.274 vs -0.50 for pure card luck and 0.00 for pure mix - i.e. quarterly hold noise is roughly HALF luck, HALF non-luck. Caveat: drop is a crude proxy for hands x bet^2, which is what actually drives luck variance; a low-limit grind property (Sands Macao) has less luck variance per dollar of drop than the fit implies.

cohort_test_H1_2026.sign_test: 6 of 12 Macau properties above their own trend; binomial p = 0.61
cohort_test_H1_2026.verdict: THERE IS NO COHORT-WIDE H1-2026 HOLD ELEVATION. The premise does not survive contact with the primary data. The elevation is concentrated in Wynn Palace (+5.26 sigma) and, to a lesser degree, Studio City (+2.28 sigma, Q1 only). Six of the twelve are BELOW their own trend, four of them materially: The Venetian Macao (-3.20), Sands Macao (-2.91), Wynn Macau (-2.00) and Plaza/Four Seasons (-1.24). The cohort is DIVERGING, not lifting together.
cohort_test_H1_2026.joint_probability_literal: Product of one-sided upper-tail p across all 12 Macau properties = 1.6e-12. This number is MEANINGLESS as evidence of elevation because 6 of the 12 factors exceed 0.5 (those properties are below trend); the product is small simply because it multiplies 12 numbers.
cohort_test_H1_2026.joint_probability_selected_subset: Product over the two elevated properties = 8.1e-10; after a selection correction for choosing 2 of 11 with either sign (C(12,2)*2^2 = 264) it is 2.1e-7. Even this OVERSTATES significance: (i) the properties are not independent - they share the same patron pool, the same junket/premium-agent network, the same holiday calendar and the same handful of whales, so a single large player's swing can move two properties at once; (ii) hold residuals are fat-tailed, so a Gaussian tail understates the probability of a 5-sigma print - the empirical-rank tail is a safer read; (iii) the trend is estimated from only 15-23 quarters, so the trend line itself carries error that is not propagated into these z-scores.
cohort_test_H1_2026.what_survives: Wynn Palace's H1-2026 is too large to be card luck under any plausible parametrization: the excess is +5.17pp against an implied card-luck quarterly SD of 0.65pp, i.e. about 11 luck-sigma. Something real changed at that property. What it is CANNOT be identified from disclosure - see composition_test.

_analysis.structural_drift_note: The cohort is DIVERGING, not drifting together. MGM China +1.36pp/yr, Galaxy +1.18pp/yr and Studio City +0.65pp/yr are rising; Sands Macao -0.38, Wynn Macau -0.36, Plaza/Four Seasons -0.28 and The Venetian Macao -0.25 are falling. MGM China's slope is the least trustworthy: its drop series only begins 2021Q3, so the slope is fit largely on a post-COVID recovery ramp and should not be extrapolated. MGM's own filings corroborate the drift qualitatively - the '16% to 22% of table games drop' expected main-floor range stated in 2019 was quietly dropped from later filings and actual hold now runs 25-27%.
_analysis.external_control_nevada: Nevada GCB Las Vegas Strip BACCARAT hold ran 12.71% (2015) -> 16.27% (2025), an OLS drift of +0.359pp per year on a completely different regulator, customer base and drop definition (cash + markers in the box, no cage component). Structural upward drift in table hold-on-drop is therefore a REAL cross-market phenomenon, not a Macau accounting artifact - which is precisely why every 2026 z-score here is measured against a fitted trend rather than a flat historical mean. Nevada Strip baccarat H1-2026 monthly hold ran 13.01 / 14.66 / 20.13 / 16.49 / 19.66 / 16.82 (mean ~16.8) - above the 2025 full year of 16.27 but well inside its own monthly range, i.e. no Las Vegas hold anomaly either.

composition_test.instrument: Wynn is the only operator disclosing a mix instrument: VIP vs mass average table counts per property per quarter. Implied mass drop per table per day is a proxy for buy-in intensity, and hold-on-drop = edge x (handle/drop), so a shift toward higher-recycle premium-mass play should show up as LOWER drop per table with HIGHER hold.
composition_test.raw_movement: Wynn Palace 2025Q2->2026Q2: mass tables 249->287 (+15.3%), mass drop +3.0%, drop/table/day $81,385->$72,750 (-10.6%), win/table/day $18,149->$21,607 (+19.1%), hold 22.3%->29.7%. Wynn Macau moved the OPPOSITE way: mass tables 231->213, drop/table/day $76,961->$90,383 (+17.4%), hold 17.4%->17.1%. Both properties saw VIP tables collapse (Palace 52->47, Macau 21->10), so VIP play is migrating into the mass denominator at both.
composition_test.NEGATIVE_RESULT: The instrument FAILS. Regressing hold on drop/table/day over the 15 non-COVID quarters 2018-2025 gives, at Wynn Palace, a slope of -0.020pp per $1,000 with t = -0.46 and r = -0.13; at Wynn Macau +0.024pp per $1,000, t = +0.49, r = +0.14. Neither is distinguishable from zero. Applying the fitted relationship attributes only +0.17pp of Wynn Palace's +7.4pp YoY move to mix and leaves +7.23pp unexplained.
composition_test.conclusion: COMPOSITION CANNOT BE ESTIMATED DIRECTLY FROM PRIMARY DISCLOSURE at any property. No operator publishes a premium-mass vs base-mass split, and the only available proxy has no in-sample explanatory power. The desk should NOT claim the Wynn Palace move is a premium-mass mix shift - that hypothesis is CONSISTENT with the table-count and per-table data but is NOT identified by it. Treat Wynn Palace H1-2026 as an unexplained outlier and put the question to the company directly.
